attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "Massive overhaul of the core OrchardCore.Resources module (ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs with +849/-207 lines, restructured vendor asset paths, jQuery/Bootstrap/Vue/FontAwesome vendor bundling changes, and a full build-tooling rewrite) that affects the shared resource manifest every tenant/module/theme in the framework depends on, making regressions highly likely and impossible to fully verify without a senior review of the huge diff."

{"risk": 5, "reason": "Massive overhaul of the entire front-end asset pipeline (build scripts, webpack/parcel/sass config, dependency version bumps) plus a rewritten ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs (+849/-207) that redefines resource paths, vendor versions (Bootstrap, jQuery, Vue, FontAwesome relocated from wwwroot to Assets), and CDN/resource names used by every module and downstream theme/module referencing these shared script/style manifests, so any mismatch breaks admin UI, editors (Trumbowyg/CodeMirror/Monaco), and any custom module relying on the old resource names or file locations across all tenants."
